criteria.text: A production database is restored to a point in time five minutes before a simulated error, within the agreed time
criteria.how: Drop a table on a copy of production, restore to the minute before, and time it end to end.

criteria.text: A masked copy of a production database is delivered to a development team in under an hour, with no DBA ticket
criteria.how: Have one team request a clone through self-service and check that sensitive columns are masked.

criteria.text: The whole fleet moves to an approved patch level in one maintenance window, with a tested rollback
criteria.how: Patch a group of test databases together, then roll one back.

criteria.text: A new database is provisioned from an approved profile in minutes, with backup already on
criteria.how: Request one, then check its backup policy without touching it.

criteria.text: A database server failure leaves the clustered database available with no manual step
criteria.how: Stop the primary node during a test load and watch the service continue.

readiness: A copy of a production database cleared for the test, or a representative one
Database engine versions and licences in scope listed
A DBA and an application team ready to try self-service
The columns to mask agreed with the data owner
Backup target and retention for the test
